changelog: The voice keyboard now tells you when it hears nothing: if you dictate in WhatsApp or Messenger and 10 seconds pass with no speech, it shows 'কিছু শোনা যাচ্ছে না — মাইকের কাছে জোরে বলুন' instead of silently restarting until the session ends. The main app has had this hint since v7.7 — now the keyboard has it too, so a muted mic or a phone in a pocket is visible right away.
